page.layout: One page of text, two medallion illustrations at the top, centred above the text. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Two entries in the main column, each with a short italic verse passage (in indented lines) and a closing line. No margin notes. Text runs in one column, full width.

main_text.l: ÆLIA Petina Consulari patre nata, mox, repudiata
Plautia Herculanilla, nupsit Claudio Imp. cum qua item diuortium
fecit, ob leuiculas offensas. ex hac Antonia suscepit quam
Cneo Pompeio magno, deinde Fausto Sylle collocauit, quorum
alter à Pompeio magno, alter à Fausto Sylla, Syllæ Felicis filio
nupsit: hanc cum coperisset vir, super cætera flagitia atq;
dedecora, se absente, Caio Silio, iuuetutis Romanæ pulcherrimo,
etiam nupsisse, dote inter Auspices cosignata, curauit interfici.
Vide Cor. Taci. li. II. ad calcem. De hac item sic scribit Iuue. Saty. 6.

l.i: Linquebat comite ancilla non amplius una,
Et nigrum flauo crinem abscondente galero,
Et cellam vacuam, atque suam: tunc nuda papillis
Excepit blanda intrantes, atque ara popolcit:
Et lassata viris, nondum satiata recessit:
Fœda lupanaris tulit ad puluinar odorem.

main_text.l: ex hac Messalina Clau. Octauiâ, & quem primò Germanicum,
mox Britannicum cognominauit, suscepit. Vide vt supra.

page.notes: Two round medallion portraits at top: left labelled "AELIA PETINA CLAV. IMP. VXOR", right labelled "VALERIA MESSALINA CL. IMP. VX" (lettering partly curved and partly hard to read; the right legend reads "VALERIA MESSAL. CL. IMP. VX" as far as legible). The verse lines are italic. Some letters in the verse are faint and were read with care, e.g. "Obscuríque", "popolcit" (likely "popouit" or "popofcit" in print; read as printed), "Lycisca" uncertain. Lines marked with an accent or stroke over "Aufa" are as printed. Ordinary printed "s" forms are rendered as plain s.
